node.title: Re: Which incarnation of try/catch to use?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: IMHO, [mod://Try::Tiny] is the "best" (simplest, most portable) module. Like [Haarg], I am wondering what you mean by "eval { } can't do that" - one of the simplest ways to do try/catch built in to Perl is eval { ...; 1 } or do { ... }; ([id://11130946|but not] eval { ... }; if ($@) { ... }!)
